title: Evaluating the effect of vitamin D supplementation on serum levels of 25-hydroxy vitamin D, 1,25-dihydroxy vitamin D, parathyroid hormone and renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system
reason: Only 5 RCTs; SMD only; ChatGPT used in data extraction; weaker than Mirhosseini 2018 and Bover 2021 for PTH

title: Serum Parathyroid Hormone Responses to Vitamin D Supplementation in Overweight/Obese Adults
reason: Pooled within-group pre/post SMDs, not vitamin D vs control; single screener

title: Dose-response effects of vitamin D supplementation on vitamin D status, glycosylated hemoglobin and total cholesterol in patients with diabetes mellitus
reason: Seven papers (468 patients) mixing RCTs and retrospective studies; high vs low dose only; printed CI for TC is inconsistent with its estimate

title: Comparison of vitamin D2 and vitamin D3 supplementation in raising serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D status
reason: Fetched; superseded by van den Heuvel 2024 (daily dosing, LC-MS/MS, BMI subgroups); not extracted to avoid overlap

title: Long-term supplementation with 3200 to 4000 IU of vitamin D daily and adverse events
reason: Hypercalcaemia reported only as relative risk (RR 2.21), no mean difference in serum calcium; brief asks for MD with CI

title: A Meta-Analysis of High Dose, Intermittent Vitamin D Supplementation among Older Adults
reason: No serum calcium or other target biomarker mean difference with CI in the text

title: Effects of vitamin D supplements on bone metabolism in kidney transplant recipients
reason: Most trials used active vitamin D (calcitriol, alfacalcidol, paricalcitol), not supplemental D2/D3

title: Relative Efficacy of Vitamin D2 and Vitamin D3 in Improving Vitamin D Status
reason: Fetched; covers the same D2 vs D3 question as van den Heuvel 2024, which was preferred (daily dosing, LC-MS/MS MD, BMI subgroups); not extracted to avoid overlap
